title: MINOR IN THE SOCIOLOGY OF GENDER (Brescia) Faculty of Social Science - Sociology

sections.heading: MINOR IN THE SOCIOLOGY OF GENDER (Brescia)
lines: Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 from Sociology courses at the 1000 level with a mark of at least 60% in each course.
2.0 courses from: Sociology 2172A/B, Sociology 2235, Sociology 2239, Sociology 3360F/G.

1.0 course from: English 2705F/G, English 2715F/G, GSWS 1020E, History 2803E, Religious Studies 2222F/G, Religious Studies 2251F/G, Religious Studies 2253F/G, the former History 2183A/B, the former Philosophy 2067E and "Special Topics" courses in Sociology with permission of the Chair.
Prior to May 1, 2024, this module was offered by Brescia University College.
